title: Akash Levy · weighted numerator
method: Replaces the pointwise numerator bound in the cubic-theta probe of OpenAI's argument by a weighted fourth moment of the reflected physical numerator: Mellin inversion and the Hecke functional equation reduce the actual smoothed numerator sum to a plain polynomial of length at most U/Y, and the unused length carries selected prime factors in the original fourth moment, while a coefficient-norm argument controls the original Euler correction and its ramified error terms. The moment parameter stays at the original kappa = 3/4; with ell = 167/1000, theta = 11/12 - ell/4 = 10499/12000, and the finite exponent comparisons are exact rational certificates. Lean 4.34.1 development of 228 modules on the akashlevy/math fork (c388e88e6) of OpenAI/math fd4aeeb, with Mathlib d13f23b7; it proves zeta, all-Dirichlet and finite-order Hecke nonvanishing for Re s > 10499/12000.
